title: 👮 Flock Searches for the LOLs | EFFector 38.16
summary: EFF's EFFector 38.16 newsletter promotes a new EFF report finding that police officers nationwide routinely log nonsensical justifications like 'LOL' and 'LMAO' when running Flock ALPR searches. The issue also covers state pushback against ALPRs and features a podcast interview with EFF's Adam Schwartz on the growing backlash against Flock cameras.

key_quotes.quote: officers across the country are routinely logging completely nonsensical "reasons" for their Flock searches, including "LOL," "LMAO," and even (yuck) "Sexy."
what has united people against Flock cameras — and how we can make sure that today's backlash leads to lasting change
